Begriffe, die in Household immer wieder: Terms that come up again and again in Household, briefly explained.
Administratoren verwalten Benutzer, Modu: Administrators manage users, modules, backups and policies. Editors maintain the household's records. Readers see the records they may see but change nothing.
Einkauf, Vorrat, Kochbuch, Planung, Fina: Shopping, pantry, cookbook, planning, finance, vehicles, chores, meters and documents can each be switched on. A switched-off module keeps its data; it is deleted permanently only through a separate deletion request.
Zusätzlich zum Passwort bestätigst du di: In addition to your password, you confirm the sign-in with a six-digit code from an authenticator app or with a passkey. Someone who only knows your password cannot get into your account.
Ein Passkey meldet dich mit Fingerabdruc: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face recognition, device PIN or security key. Household stores no biometric data, only a public key.
Einmal verwendbare Codes für den Fall, d: Single-use codes for when you cannot reach your authenticator app. Keep them apart from your phone.
Administratoren können verlangen, dass K: Administrators can require accounts with extended rights to set up a second factor. After the grace period, affected accounts can reach only their security settings.
Ein verschlüsselter Wiederherstellungspu: An encrypted restore point with all of the household's data and files. The backup service creates it on schedule; older points are removed according to the configured retention.
Eine Kopie der Sicherungen außerhalb die: A copy of the backups outside this computer, for example in S3 storage or on a NAS. It protects against theft, fire and disk failure.
Household stellt eine Sicherung probewei: Household restores a backup into a check database of its own, checks all data and files and deletes the check database afterwards. Only then does a backup count as tested.
Setzt den ganzen Haushalt auf einen Wied: Returns the whole household to a restore point. Household first backs up the current state, pauses briefly and then signs everyone out. The previous state is kept until an administrator discards it.
Hinweise auf dem Telefon oder Computer ü: Notices on your phone or computer through Web Push. You allow each device separately; the message contains no private content.
Einkaufslisten und Rezepte bleiben auf f: Shopping lists and recipes stay readable on allowed devices without a connection. Changes are sent once the device is online again.
Administratoren sehen, wer wann was geän: Administrators see who changed what and when. Protected fields show only that they changed, not their content.
Administratoren laden die Einträge der e: Administrators download the records of the enabled modules as a ZIP file of CSV tables, for example for a move. The export contains no files. Areas that are too large or that you may not see are left out and listed under omitted in manifest.json. Use the backup for a complete copy.
Fotos und PDFs, die du aus einer anderen: Photos and PDFs you shared with Household from another app. They stay only on this device until you save them.

Lade alle Einträge deines Haushalts als: Download all of your household's records as a ZIP file with one CSV table per area, for example for a move. The export contains no files or documents; use the documents export and the backup for those.

Es gibt noch keine externe Kopie. Starte: There is no offsite copy yet. Start an offsite backup on the backup page.
